name: Isogeometric Volume Rendering
definition: A method for interactive visualization of isogeometric analysis (IGA) results, ensuring correct, pixel-accurate geometry of the volume including its bounding surfaces. It extends classic volume rendering to isogeometric volumes where both geometry and scalar field are given in terms of splines (NURBS, B-splines).
summary: Isogeometric Volume Rendering is an interactive visualization method that uses splines to ensure pixel-accurate geometry, avoiding the block-like structures and memory demands of voxelized approaches.
